::: {#thm-corekv2 name='Invertible matrix theorem'} 
\index{Invertible matrix theorem}
The following are equivalent for an $n\times n$-matrix $A$: 

1. $A$ is row equivalent with $I_n$. 
2. $A\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{0}$ has $\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{0}$ as the only solution. 
3. $A\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{b}$ has a unique solution for all right hand sides $\mathbf{b}$. 
4. $A$ can be written as a product of elementary matrices. 
5. $A$ is invertible.

:::
